source_note: 制造telescoping sum求和或求乘积
english_source_note: Using Telescoping Sums for Sums and Products
callout_id: 制造telescoping sum求和或求乘积#9
statement_en:
Let \(q\\geq 2\) be a positive integer, and let the real number \(a\) satisfy \(|a|<1\). Show that
$$\\prod_{n\\geq 0}(1+a^{q^n}+\\cdots+a^{(q-1)q^n})=\\frac{1}{1-a}.$$
callout_body: 令$q\geq 2$是一个正整数实数$a$满足$|a|<1$那么$$\prod_{n\geq 0}(1+a^{q^n}+\cdots+a^{(q-1)q^n})=\frac{1}{1-a}$$
